title: Molecular Expression and Prognostic Implications of Kruppel-Like Factor 3 (KLF3) in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma.
authors: Wan, Bin; Zhang, Wensheng; Deng, Xinxi; Lu, Yigang; Zhang, Zhuo; Yang, Yang
journal: Critical reviews in eukaryotic gene expression
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KLF3在肾透明细胞癌中的表达与预后关联，属于纯临床表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A major subtype of renal cancer is clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Kruppel-like factor 3 (KLF3) dysfunction is also revealed leading to poor prognosis in multiple cancer types. However, dysregulation and molecular dynamics of KLF3 underlying ccRCC progression still remains elusive. Here KLF3 gene and protein expressions in ccRCC were explored using data cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), Human Protein Atlas (HPA), Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC) and verified them in our patient cohort. Correlations of KLF3 expression with clinicopathological features, epigenetic modification, and immune microenvironment characteristics were further investigated. KLF3 was significantly down-regulated expressed in ccRCC tissues compared to adjacent normal controls. Adverse pathological parameters and poor prognosis were associated with lower expression of KLF3. Mechanically, KLF3 regulation was mainly attributed to CpG island methylation. KLF3-high expression subgroup was significantly enriched in cell signaling pathways most associated with EMT markers, angiogenesis, inflammatory response, apoptosis, TGF-beta, degradation of ECM, G2M checkpoint, and PI3K-AKT-mTOR. Based on GDSC database, KLF3 upregulation was identified to be associated with higher sensitivities towards PI3K-Akt-mTOR pathway inhibitors such as PI-103, PIK-93, and OSI-027. In addition, patients with down-regulated KLF3 expressions were found more sensitive towards Trametinib, Cetuximab, and Erlotinib. Collectively, our findings suggest that KLF3 may act as a suitable biomarker for prognosis prediction, tumor microenvironment (TME) phenotype identification, thereby helping ccRCC patients to make better therapeutic decisions.
abstract_zh: 肾癌的一种主要亚型是透明细胞肾细胞癌 (clear cell renal cell carcinoma, ccRCC)。Kruppel样因子3 (Kruppel-like factor 3, KLF3) 的功能障碍也被揭示在多种癌症类型中导致不良预后。然而，KLF3在ccRCC进展中的失调和分子动力学仍不清楚。本研究利用来自癌症基因组图谱 (The Cancer Genome Atlas, TCGA)、人类蛋白质图谱 (Human Protein Atlas, HPA)、临床蛋白质组肿瘤分析联盟 (Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium, CPTAC) 的数据队列，探讨了ccRCC中KLF3基因和蛋白的表达，并在我们的患者队列中进行了验证。进一步研究了KLF3表达与临床病理特征、表观遗传修饰和免疫微环境特征的相关性。与邻近正常对照相比，KLF3在ccRCC组织中的表达显著下调。较低的KLF3表达与不良病理参数和较差预后相关。机制上，KLF3的调控主要归因于CpG岛甲基化。KLF3高表达亚组在与EMT标志物、血管生成、炎症反应、凋亡、TGF-β、ECM降解、G2M检查点和PI3K-AKT-mTOR相关的细胞信号通路中显著富集。基于GDSC数据库，KLF3上调被确定与对PI3K-Akt-mTOR通路抑制剂（如PI-103、PIK-93和OSI-027）的更高敏感性相关。此外，KLF3表达下调的患者被发现对Trametinib、Cetuximab和Erlotinib更敏感。总体而言，我们的发现表明KLF3可能作为预后预测和肿瘤微环境 (tumor microenvironment, TME) 表型识别的合适生物标志物，从而帮助ccRCC患者做出更好的治疗决策。
